data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nawwala', meaning to feed, take care of, or nurse. This name is used for a girl, symbolizing care, protection, and nurturing in Islamic tradition. The name Nuwayla carries the meaning “Nurse, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nuwayla usually hope their child will grow to embody nurse, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
